title: Implement spec 18.8.2 amendment: rekey invalidates ALL outstanding invitations
description: Spec/12-apps.md SS18.8.2 amended (Trust Boundaries + Delegation Revocation). Python reference rekey() now burns every outstanding invitation identity into the consumption ledger (replay refusal via existing 4u1a machinery) and clears the outstanding set; rust gateway Group.rekey tracks no invitation ledger so the sentence is trivially satisfied there. Tests: rekey-invalidates-all (join-A/rekey/B-denied/replay-refused) + mutation-lock race probe updated to both-outcomes-are-coherent per new semantics. Spec amendment authored by Mark.
